title: Open landing page and view level grid with indicators
description: Verifies the home page loads and shows the level grid with lock/completion indicators.

steps.description: Verify text "Neon Path Puzzle" is visible
Verify element "a level card" is visible
Verify element "lock indicator on at least one level card" is visible

title: Start an unlocked level from the grid
description: Verifies clicking an unlocked level card opens the gameplay screen for that level.

steps.description: Verify element "an unlocked level card" is visible

title: Return to home from gameplay screen
description: Verifies the user can return to the landing page from a level and see the level grid again.

title: Locked level cannot be opened
description: Verifies clicking a locked level card shows a locked message/tooltip and does not navigate to gameplay.

steps.description: Verify element "a locked level card" is visible

title: Completion indicator appears after completing a level
description: Verifies that completing a level updates the corresponding level card completion status on the home screen.

steps.description: Verify element "completed indicator on the just-played level card" is visible

title: Progress persists after reload (local save)
description: Verifies that a completed level remains marked completed after reloading the home page in the same browser.

steps.description: Verify element "completed indicator on the just-played level card" is visible

title: Theme selector does not block level selection
description: Verifies that changing theme on the landing page still allows starting a level successfully.

steps.description: Select "a different theme option" from dropdown

title: Start a level from the home level grid and load the gameplay UI
description: Verifies a player can start a level from the landing page and see the gameplay canvas and lives header.

steps.description: Click on the first visible level card in the level grid

title: Attempt to use Hint when it is unavailable and verify no hint appears
description: Verifies the UI prevents hint usage when hints are unavailable and no suggested segment is shown.

steps.description: Click on the first visible level card in the level grid
Use Hint repeatedly until the Hint control becomes disabled or indicates no hints remain
Verify element "suggested path segment" is not visible

title: View achievements list with progress indicators
description: Verifies the Achievements panel opens and shows unlocked/upcoming achievements with visible progress indicators.

steps.description: Verify an element "Achievement progress" is visible

title: Open an achievement to view details
description: Verifies clicking an achievement in the list opens a details view for that achievement.

steps.description: Verify an element "Achievement list" is visible
Click on the first visible achievement in the list
Verify an element "Achievement details" is visible
Click on the "Back" control in the achievement details view
Verify an element "Achievement list" is visible

title: Change theme from theme selector and see immediate update on Home
description: Verifies selecting a different neon theme updates the Home screen visuals immediately.

steps.description: Verify an element "Theme options" is visible
Click on a theme option that is not currently selected
Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible
Verify an element "Particle effects" is visible
Verify an element "Glow effects" is visible

title: Theme is applied when starting a level from Home
description: Verifies the selected theme carries over from Home into the gameplay view.

steps.description: Click on a theme option that is not currently selected
Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible
Click on the first visible level tile in the level grid
Verify an element "Game board" is visible
Verify an element "Game theme visuals" is visible

title: Theme selection persists after page refresh (normal case)
description: Verifies a chosen theme remains selected after refreshing the page during a normal session.

steps.description: Click on a theme option that is not currently selected
Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible
Press "Enter" on the selected theme option to confirm selection
Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible

title: Achievements panel remains usable after changing theme
description: Verifies switching themes does not break the Achievements UI and the list/details still open correctly.

steps.description: Click on a theme option that is not currently selected
Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible
Verify an element "Achievement list" is visible
Click on the first visible achievement in the list
Verify an element "Achievement details" is visible

title: Theme selector can be closed without changing theme
description: Verifies the theme selector can be opened and dismissed and the current theme remains unchanged.

steps.description: Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible
Verify an element "Theme options" is visible
Verify an element "Theme options" is not visible
Verify an element "Selected theme" is visible
